page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8a.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs from an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 4 physical cores with 1 thread per core, backed by 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25%. Multi-core performance is average, as shown by the stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core metrics. However, memory read bandwidth is weak, falling into the bottom 25% for both small cached and large uncached blocks, though write bandwidth for large blocks remains average. Cryptographic capabilities are supported by hardware-accelerated instructions including AES, VAES, and SHA_NI.

The high memory-to-vCPU ratio makes this instance qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-throughput local storage or massive multi-threaded compute. Due to weak database operations and Redis SET performance in benchmarks, it is best suited for memory-bound applications, text processing, and caching layers that fit entirely within the 32.0 GB RAM envelope without demanding high disk I/O or extreme memory read bandwidth.
